name: Which paint colors and sheens work best when prepping a foreclosure for resale or rent?

mainEntity.name: Which paint colors and sheens work best when prepping a foreclosure for resale or rent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Investors flipping or renting out a foreclosure should choose neutral, light tones like soft warm grays, greiges, or warm whites. These colors reflect natural light, make neglected spaces feel clean and expansive, and appeal to the widest pool of potential buyers or renters. For durability, use an eggshell or satin finish on living room and bedroom walls because flat paint scuffs easily and is difficult to wipe down between tenants. For high-moisture bathrooms, kitchens, and baseboard trim, semi-gloss provides the best moisture resistance and cleanability against daily wear and tear.
acceptedAnswer.description: Neutral tones like greige or soft off-white in an eggshell or satin finish work best for walls, paired with durable semi-gloss for trim, kitchens, and baths.
